recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core FHIR. Any current maintenance of ShareableActivityDefinition should occur in CRMI rather than restoring the profile in this repository.
issue_request: FHIR-32637 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested adding cqf-knowledgeCapability and cqf-knowledgeRepresentationLevel to ShareableActivityDefinition; the accepted resolution also required cqf-artifactComment, matching ShareableLibrary.
initial_application: Jira-linked commit 8a1fd9b3b65c6070800135d3ac41bad3271253c3 added the three extension slices to source/activitydefinition/structuredefinition-profile-shareableactivitydefinition.xml. Same-day commit 5186181258472403e683678d1f98d14b895aa8fd removed an accidental duplicate knowledgeCapability slice, leaving the requested set present.
additional_context: FHIR-48393 was later Applied/Persuasive for R6 and removed ShareableActivityDefinition, ShareableLibrary, and related Shareable/Publishable profiles from the base specification because they moved to CRMI. Commit 571498e2b2959573e07980c9117923b42624e3a1 deleted the ShareableActivityDefinition profile source, and current module/pattern narrative directs implementers to CRMI for these profiles.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding the extension slices in core would recreate a profile that a later final R6 decision removed from the current build.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 decision that removed ShareableActivityDefinition and related Shareable/Publishable profiles from core and moved profile maintenance to CRMI.
